item.title: National train service scaled back all weekend due to snow and ice
item.description: Trains in the Netherlands will continue to run on a reduced timetable all weekend, with freezing temperatures predicted Friday through Sunday during both daytime and overnight hours, said ProRail.

item.description: Electronics chain Coolblue will start selling bicycle helmets, CEO Pieter Zwart announced on LinkedIn.

item.title: Booker Prize nominee Astrid Roemer dead at age 78
item.description: Celebrated Dutch-Surinamese author Astrid Roemer died on Thursday, publishing company Prometheus announced on social media. The 78-year-old passed away at her residence in Paramaribo, Suriname.

item.title: Dutch road authority preparing for -20°C wind chill, snow, and fog this weekend
item.description: The protocol for severe cold weather along Dutch roads will be in place from 6 p.m. on Saturday.

item.title: Almost 40% of former Blokker stores still empty a year after bankruptcy
item.description: Almost 40 percent of the stores that were owned by retail chain Blokker prior to their bankruptcy are still empty a year later.
